storyline.real: Barrichello starts on pole and leads most of the race. Ferrari order him to let Schumacher win, and he yields on the last lap: Schumacher wins by 0.18 s.
storyline.headline: No swap at the A1-Ring: Barrichello keeps his win

mastery.label: Ferrari one-two on one more stop

hidden.label: Bring the one-two home without a single push lap

eras.briefing: A1-Ring, 2002. The safety car is out and both Ferraris have just refuelled under it. You run Barrichello, on pole and leading; Schumacher is third, behind Ralf Schumacher, who has yet to stop. One more stop each. Bring the Ferraris home one-two.
